scope_marking_rules.EXPLICIT_PARENT_IDENTITY_ONLY: Only exact explicit purpose prefix Fixed parent identity for received bounded contract. This does not discard range units elsewhere.
scope_marking_rules.EXPLICIT_RANGE_OR_COMPLETE_UNIT: A path-bearing record (or its direct identity wrapper) contains literal lines/range/ranges/line_range/complete_unit_ranges_inclusive. No inferred function boundaries.
scope_marking_rules.foreign_repository: Explicit repo/repository differs from /workspace/pokemon-essentials-clean-room. This includes the expected reference repository; it is not a scope violation finding.
scope_marking_rules.foreign_contract: Explicit nearest GR8 id/contract_id is outside the selected 23. Cross-contract textual references are preserved verbatim elsewhere and are not reclassified by the helper.
scope_marking_rules.pointer_precision: All source_JSON_pointer addresses preserve original unfiltered canonical array indices.

prompt_obligations_extraction_rule: Exact shared preamble once; all six residual prompt texts and all six assignment JSON blocks retained verbatim. Only the 23 contract JSON blocks proven strictly equal to canonical records are replaced by exact fixed-commit/path/JSON-pointer addresses. These addresses do not replace root reading the canonical full contracts.

contract_value_extraction.qualification: Mechanical key-based extraction only; no judgment that each included value is behavioral or that an excluded locator is dispensable. Root reads remaining unique values and all required declared units.
contract_value_extraction.hash_token_rule: Only an entire 40/64-digit hexadecimal scalar token is treated as hash identity. Natural-language strings containing hashes are retained.
contract_value_extraction.deduplication_rule: Exact scalar value plus JSON scalar type. String whitespace, punctuation, spelling, and case are unchanged. All canonical source pointers retained.
